# Kind support per target and channel

Which artifact kinds each target delivers on each channel. `scaffold` = files written into a
project by `sigil add` (and the target's `sigil build` layout); `plugin` = marketplace plugins
built by `sigil build`. `native` = emitted as its own file or config fragment; `via inline` =
carried inside the skills that `uses:` it; `—` = not delivered (see the numbered note). Why the
channels are split this way: [distribution-channels-2026-09](../decisions/distribution-channels-2026-09.md).

## scaffold

| Kind | claude | copilot |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mcp | native | native |
| hook | native | — (1) |
| settings | native | — (1) |
| prompt | native | native |
| skill | native | native |
| agent | native | native |
| rule | native | native |
| workflow | native | native |
| template | — (2) | — (2) |

1. this kind's schema is Claude Code's own vocabulary — sigil has no Copilot emitter for it
2. templates are composed into other artifacts at resolve time, never emitted

## plugin

| Kind | claude |
| --- | --- |
| mcp | — (1) |
| hook | — (1) |
| settings | — (2) |
| prompt | — (1) |
| skill | native |
| agent | native |
| rule | via inline (3) |
| workflow | native |
| template | — (4) |

1. sigil does not package this kind into plugins yet — install it with `sigil add`
2. a plugin settings.json applies only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine` — [Claude Code — Plugin components](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/components)
3. folded into each skill that `uses:` it — [Claude Code — Plugin components](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/components)
4. templates are composed into other artifacts at resolve time, never emitted
